shortDescription: Adds or removes a Windows PowerShell module

options.name: accept_license
options.description: Accepts the module's license. Required for modules that require license acceptance, since interactively answering the prompt is not possible. Corresponds to the C(-AcceptLicense) parameter of C(Install-Module). Installation of a module or a dependency that requires license acceptance cannot be detected in check mode, but will cause a failure at runtime unless I(accept_license=true).

options.name: allow_clobber
options.description: If C(yes) allows install modules that contains commands those have the same names as commands that already exists.

options.name: allow_prerelease
options.description: If C(yes) installs modules marked as prereleases. It doesn't work with the parameters C(minimum_version) and/or C(maximum_version). It doesn't work with the C(state) set to absent.

options.name: force
options.description: Overrides warning messages about module installation conflicts If there is an existing module with the same name and version, force overwrites that version Corresponds to the C(-Force) parameter of C(Install-Module). If module as dependency, it will also force reinstallation of dependency. Updating them to latest if version isn't specified in module manifest.

options.name: maximum_version
options.description: The maximum version of the PowerShell module that has to be installed.

options.name: minimum_version
options.description: The minimum version of the PowerShell module that has to be installed.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the Windows PowerShell module that has to be installed.

options.name: password
options.description: Password to authenticate against private repository.

options.name: repository
options.description: Name of the custom repository to use.

options.name: required_version
options.description: The exact version of the PowerShell module that has to be installed.

options.name: skip_publisher_check
options.description: If C(yes), allows you to install a different version of a module that already exists on your computer in the case when a different one is not digitally signed by a trusted publisher and the newest existing module is digitally signed by a trusted publisher.

options.name: state
options.description: If C(present) a new module is installed. If C(absent) a module is removed. If C(latest) a module is updated to the newest version.

options.name: username
options.description: Username to authenticate against private repository.
